verdict.rationale: First-party docs show OneDrive Files On-Demand in File Explorer: users can browse and interact with cloud files without downloading them, and pin individual files with 'Always keep on this device'. This covers the on-demand/online-only part of the story on Windows. Community hands-on reports are mixed: some users describe sync deleting, reverting or corrupting files, while others report years of trouble-free multi-machine sync, so 'just works' is contested but not clearly refuted. Missing for 10: evidence of an official macOS desktop client, documented selective (folder-level) sync, and independent corroboration of reliable cross-machine sync.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files

citations.quote: OneDrive Files On-Demand enables users to view, search for, and interact with files stored in OneDrive from within File Explorer, without downloading all the files to their device.
